g.title: DT12_CABIN
g.text: Cabin side — permanent on cabin harness. Sockets, size-16 contacts.

DT-12 is the ONLY dedicated firewall crossing for MaxxECU RACE H2O signals in this build. The MaxxECU sits in the engine bay (OEM E-box cavity, intake side = passenger side of RHD car — see docs/vendor/maxxecu/MaxxECU_RACE_H2O.md). All engine sensor, IGN, INJ, and GPO actuator signals stay engine-bay entirely — no AS79 bulkhead, no Maven HD30 crossing.

The OEM E36 X20 25-pin firewall connector (harnesses/body-x20.wv) is UNCHANGED and carries only OEM body signals (A/C control, reverse light, ignition switch, alternator+). No new ECU signals traverse X20.

CAN topology (pins 1/2/3): twisted pair with shield drain per ISO 11898-2:2016 (High- speed CAN transceiver, twisted-pair, 120Ω differential). Shield drain terminates at the ECU end only (single-end drain) to prevent ground loops. 120Ω termination lives at MaxxECU (internal) and at the far end of the cabin CAN bus (Gauge.S or DCT shifter, whichever is physically last).

APS topology (pins 4-9): two independent redundant channels per Bosch DBW safety convention. Each channel has its own SGND and +5V — do NOT bridge SGND1↔SGND2 or +5V1↔+5V2 anywhere. Twisted pairs (SGND with its own +5V) minimize common-mode noise. Signal wires (pins 6, 9) are single-ended 0.5-4.5V ratiometric.

Sealed USB cable (MaxxECU #1606) routes through a SEPARATE weatherproof grommet alongside the DT-12 — the sealed molded ECU-side connector will not pass through a DT cavity. See docs/vendor/maxxecu/MaxxECU_RACE_H2O.md §5.

g.title: W_DT12_CROSSING
g.text: DT12_ENGINE:1:CAN H → MaxxECU C1 E1 (CMC CAN H)
DT12_ENGINE:2:CAN L → MaxxECU C1 E2 (CMC CAN L)
DT12_ENGINE:3:Shield drain → MaxxECU C1 H1 (SGND) or backshell
DT12_ENGINE:6:APS1 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS1 AIN
DT12_ENGINE:9:APS2 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS2 AIN
Length is a placeholder — measure from the cabin-side APS pedal + CAN devices through the firewall grommet to the DT12_CABIN mating face on the engine-bay side.

SHIELD: CAN pair (wires 1/2) and APS pairs (4/5 and 7/8) should share a common overall foil shield for the entire cable run. Shield drain (wire 3) terminates only at the ECU end (in the engine bay). At the cabin end the shield floats.

TWISTING: within the shielded bundle, twist CAN H/L as one pair, APS SGND1+VCC1 as a second pair, APS SGND2+VCC2 as a third pair. This preserves the differential /reference topology for each function.

g.title: DT12_ENGINE
g.text: Engine bay side — mates DT12_CABIN. Pins, size-16 contacts.
CAN H → MaxxECU C1 E1 (CMC CAN H)
CAN L → MaxxECU C1 E2 (CMC CAN L)
Shield drain → MaxxECU C1 H1 (SGND) or backshell
APS1 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS1 AIN
APS2 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS2 AIN

Mates DT12_CABIN at the firewall face on the engine-bay side of the firewall grommet. Pin-side of the connector pair, so the removable engine harness holds the pins. When unmated (harness pulled for engine service), pins are exposed on the engine harness — no cabin-side voltages are present on pins in that state, which is the safer configuration for this signal-level crossing.
Destination pin numbers refer to MaxxECU RACE C1 (48-pin) and C2 (32-pin) — see docs/vendor/maxxecu/MaxxECU_GEN1_Pinout.md and docs/vendor/maxxecu/MaxxECU_RACE_REV9plus_Wiring.pdf.

⚠️ Verify MaxxECU APS1/APS2 physical pin numbers on C2 against the RACE REV9+ wiring diagram at build time. C2 pin assignments are captured for the 07K phase in harnesses/maxxecu-07k.wv (search: APS).
